decisions.reason: Reducing the founder's proceeds by applicable fiat fees does not change which NFT asset must be minted.
The fee-allocation decision does not change the Transak provider, supported payment methods, buyer profile, or wallet requirement.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already states in anti_scam_explanation that the client's $4 share is reduced by fiat fees, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Fiat-fee treatment of the founder's proceeds does not alter winner eligibility, ticket weighting, randomness, or verification.
The source decision does not require any change to the ticket counters, badges, or referral code displayed in NFT metadata.
The NFT mint number remains the permanent referral code in the same display locations regardless of founder fee treatment.
The founder's fiat-fee treatment does not change the no-code trigger, random recipient, $5 commission, or ticket award.
The optional confirmation email and its referral-code content are unaffected by how fiat fees reduce founder proceeds.
The source preserves the remaining revenue for commissions and prize pools and does not change the candidate's funding sale types or duration.
Founder fee allocation does not alter email authentication, dashboard access, magic links, or intended users.
The referral badge thresholds and award conditions are independent of fiat-fee treatment.
The founder's fiat-fee treatment does not change the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
